messages:
Ava: Daily async check-in — what I did / blockers / today
Ava: Did: finalized SEO headings + meta for the benchmark blog post, drafted CTAs.
Ava: Blocker: waiting on hero image approval from design (Maya).
Ava: Today: follow up with design, push final draft to #docs-review, ping infra for bench slot.

Jonas: Got the preliminary benchmark run outputs, uploading charts to GCS now. Noticed a 3% tail-latency bump on the larger model.
Jonas: Will add a short note in the draft about tail-latency and mitigation ideas.

Priya: I can chase the image approval. Pinged @Maya in DMs and asked for EOD feedback.
Priya: Also updated the content calendar (row for benchmark post -> status: ready for final review).

Evan: Infra note: we have dedicated bench window Tue 10:00-12:00 UTC — I can reserve it.
Evan: Need the exact bench config you want (model, seq len, batch).

Ava: Prefer model=redwood-3b-int8, seq=1024, batch=8 for headline run. If time allows, run a 2048 seq longform sample.

Evan: Ack. Scheduling a run with that config.
Evan: ```
bench_config:
  model: redwood-3b-int8
  seq_len: 1024
  batch_size: 8
  metrics: p50,p95,p99,token_throughput
```

Liam: Quick PR update: I reviewed the blog grammar/flow PR, left two nits on the intro and approved the rest.
Liam: @Ava can you rebase when you push the final hero? :thumbsup:

Maya: Got the ping — the hero is fine with small crop tweaks. Uploading final assets to Figma now: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/marketing-assets
Maya: Will add export for web (1200x628) and mobile variants.

Priya: Awesome — once I see the export I’ll slot it into the draft and push to #docs-review. ETA 2 hours.

deploy-bot: Scheduled benchmark job queued: job_id=bench-2026-03-18-10-00, owner=@Evan.

Ava: Thanks team — plan for today: Maya finalizes hero, Priya updates calendar + inserts image, Evan runs bench Tue morning, Jonas will finalize the charts, Liam and I will do final PR polish.
Ava: Blocker resolved if image lands, otherwise I’ll move launch copy to 'hold' and coordinate next steps.

Jonas: Noted. I’ll also prepare a short appendix on latency tradeoffs to include in the post.

Liam: Approved for wordsmith pass after the image is in.

Ava: Great — ping me if anything slips. :rocket:
